commands.title: Refresh local diagnostics for open files
Refresh Pyright diagnostics for open Python files

localDiagnostics.pyright.enabled.description: Enable the local Pyright language-server diagnostics adapter.

localDiagnostics.pyright.path.description: Optional legacy path to a Pyright language server executable or JavaScript entrypoint. Defaults to the Pyright language server bundled with coc-pyright when available.

localDiagnostics.pyright.langserverPath.description: Optional path to pyright-langserver or langserver.index.js.

localDiagnostics.pyright.timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for each local Pyright language-server diagnostic request.

localDiagnostics.pyright.settleMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after opening files in the local Pyright language server before pulling diagnostics.
